records.title: A user who forgot their password resets it from a link sent to their email address.
The reset email is sent within one minute of the request.
A reset link works once; a second use is refused.
records.body: The link carries the token REQ-pr1 already bounds to 15 minutes.

records.title: The response never says whether the address has an account.
Send the link through the existing transactional mail provider.
records.body: No new dependency; its delivery log is the evidence the email went out.

ticket.title: Add password reset by email
ticket.body: A forgotten password is reset from an emailed, single-use link.

items.text: Send the reset email from the request handler
Refuse a reset link on its second use
